title: Low battery
description: Vehicle #1 starts with 25 % battery. At Stop 3 it works out that it would reach Stop 1 below 20 %, so after handing the next cycle over it takes the charging-bay spur off the return leg. On the way it drops below 20 % and raises a LOW_BATTERY DENM (and would refuse a handover). Charged to 95 %, it returns to Stop 1 and rejoins the rotation.
